title: share account SEED-SHARE-ACCT purchase: 100 shares at 100.00 MNT, no rounding surface
_note: share-account seam (no rounding surface). request.purchased_price "100.00" is share-account-detail-raw.json purchasedShares[0].purchasedPrice, the exact decimal text the oracle stored; expect.purchased_price_minor "10000" is that same value transcribed to integer minor units (2dp). request.purchased_amount "10000.00" is purchasedShares[0].amount and expect.purchased_amount_minor "1000000" is its minor-unit form: the purchase total is requestedShares 100 * unitPrice 100.00 = 10000.00, an integer-times-integer minor-unit product, so NO HALF_UP/HALF_EVEN tie exists. request.account_status_id 300 and expect.account_status_stored 300 are share-account-detail-raw.json status.id (shareAccountStatusType.active). request.purchased_status_id 300 and expect.purchased_status_stored 300 are purchasedShares[0].status.id (purchasedSharesStatusType.approved). request.total_approved_shares 100 and request.purchased_shares 100 are summary.totalApprovedShares and purchasedShares[0].numberOfShares respectively. request.total_pending_shares 0 and expect.total_pending_shares 0 are summary.totalPendingForApprovalShares: the aggregate read-back carries the pending figure (0 here). Because the observed pending figure is 0, a serialiser that merely OMITS the fold is indistinguishable from correct; the defect this cell makes visible is a summary TRANSPOSE that fills totalPendingForApprovalShares from totalApprovedShares (writes 100 into the 0 cell), which shares-wrong-summary-approved-as-pending encodes and this vector goes red on.

provenance.note: transcribed from .softhouse/capture/shares/out/share-account-detail-raw.json (account id 3): status.id 300, summary.totalApprovedShares 100, summary.totalPendingForApprovalShares 0, purchasedShares[0].numberOfShares 100, purchasedShares[0].purchasedPrice 100.00, purchasedShares[0].amount 10000.00, purchasedShares[0].status.id 300
